rising.title: Rising sign calculator
rising.description: Calculate your Ascendant from birth date, time and place. Tropical zodiac, Placidus.
rising.lead: The Ascendant is the ecliptic degree rising on the eastern horizon at birth. It needs a clock time — a twenty minute error can move it five degrees.

moon.title: Moon sign calculator
moon.description: Calculate your Moon sign from birth date, time and place.
moon.lead: The Moon moves about half a degree per hour, so a birth time still matters. Without one, the sign is usually right and the degree is a noon estimate.

venus.title: Venus sign calculator
venus.description: Calculate your Venus sign from birth date, time and place.
venus.lead: Venus changes sign every few weeks. A birth date is enough for the sign; time places it in a house.

mercury.title: Mercury sign calculator
mercury.description: Calculate your Mercury sign from birth date, time and place.
mercury.lead: Mercury changes sign every few weeks and retrogrades three times a year. A birth date is usually enough for the sign; time places it in a house.

mars.title: Mars sign calculator
mars.description: Calculate your Mars sign from birth date, time and place.
mars.lead: Mars spends about six or seven weeks in a sign. A birth date is enough for the sign; time places it in a house.

synastry.title: Synastry calculator
synastry.description: Compare two natal charts: overlay, cross-aspects and house overlays.
synastry.lead: Two charts on one wheel. Gold glyphs are person A, muted glyphs are person B. Aspects below are between the two charts, not within one.

composite.title: Composite chart calculator
composite.description: Midpoint composite chart from two birth data sets.
composite.lead: Each planet is the shorter-arc midpoint of the two natal positions. Houses follow the midpoint Ascendant in whole sign. This is a relationship chart, not a Davison (midpoint in time) chart.

home.title: Natal chart calculators
home.lead: Enter a birth date, time and place. Meridian computes tropical positions from a VSOP87 ephemeris, draws the wheel, and reads the chart from a written cache — not from a live model inventing degrees.
home.howLead: Every tool on this site takes the same three inputs. The natal calculator shows the full sky; the others isolate one question.
home.step1Body: Use the civil date on the birth record. The Sun, Mercury, Venus and Mars usually need only this for the sign.
home.step2Body: The Ascendant moves about one degree every four minutes. If the time is unknown, tick the box: planets still calculate, houses do not.
home.step3Body: Type a city. Coordinates and the IANA timezone on that date convert local clock time to Universal Time.
home.step4Body: Wheel first, then Big Three, then the light reading card, then the positions table. Save the chart to keep a full report and a day-by-day sky log.
home.toolsLead: All of them are free without an account. Synastry and composite allow one overlay; further runs need a sign-in. The natal calculator never hides the wheel.
home.methodBody: Tropical zodiac, Placidus houses by default, major aspects at 8° / 6° / 4°. Engine: astronomy-engine (VSOP87 / lunar theory). Not Swiss Ephemeris. Not sidereal, Vedic or Chinese astrology.
home.articlesLead: Longer notes on the questions people actually search: natal charts, rising signs, birth time, houses, synastry. Same voice as the rest of the site — second person, no medical or financial advice.
home.horoscopeLead: Readings computed from today’s tropical sky at 12:00 UTC — transits to 15° of each Sun sign, not a recycled column.

articles.lead: Guides written for the questions people type into Google: what a natal chart is, how to read one, what a rising sign is, and how this calculator actually computes the sky.

legal.privacyBody: Birth data used in the calculators is processed to compute the chart. Place search queries go to this site’s API, which looks up OpenStreetMap. Saved charts, sessions and daily readings are stored if you create an account. This is not medical, legal or financial advice.
legal.termsBody: Meridian is a free calculation tool. Charts are tropical astronomical positions with written interpretations from a cache. They are not medical, legal or financial advice. One synastry or composite overlay is available without an account; further relationship charts and the cabinet require a sign-in.

daily.moonReturn: The Moon is back in your natal Moon sign. The body remembers the usual comforts and the usual thin spots. Eat, rest, and do not treat a familiar mood as a new verdict.
daily.sense_conjunction: Fused: the two functions share a room and are hard to tell apart. Useful as focus, costly as a blind spot.
daily.sense_sextile: An easy door. The talent is there if you walk through; it will not chase you.
daily.sense_square: Friction that builds a skill. The two wants collide until you learn a third move.
daily.sense_trine: Ease that can go lazy. Support is native; effort has to be chosen or nothing much happens.
daily.sense_opposition: The other pole. You meet this in people, and in the part of yourself you keep across the room.
daily.longerLead: These are not one-day events. Outer-planet contacts to the natal chart last weeks to years. Read them as climate, not as a task for this afternoon.
daily.quietBody: No major transit-to-natal aspects are inside orb at noon in your birth timezone. That is not emptiness — it is a day without a loud sky cue. Do the work already on the desk.
daily.howBody: This is a sky-weather note from the natal chart you saved, computed for this calendar date at noon in that timezone. It is not medical, legal, or financial advice, and it does not replace a decision you already know you should make.
daily.house_1: The first house is the body and the entrance — how life meets you before the biography does.
daily.house_2: The second house is what you keep: money, voice, the worth you will not be talked out of.
daily.house_3: The third house is the near world — siblings, errands, the mind in traffic, the message that has to land today.
daily.house_4: The fourth house is the root: home, the private weather, the family you came from and the one you build.
daily.house_5: The fifth house is play with stakes — making, children, romance, the thing you do because it has to be seen.
daily.house_6: The sixth house is the day’s labour: work, health, the animals and systems that keep the life running.
daily.house_7: The seventh house is the other chair — partners, open enemies, the contract you cannot write alone.
daily.house_8: The eighth house is what is not yours until it is: other people’s money, sex, debt, the rooms you do not show guests.
daily.house_9: The ninth house is the far map — belief, study, travel, the story that has to be larger than the postcode.
daily.house_10: The tenth house is the skyline: vocation, reputation, the name the city uses for you.
daily.house_11: The eleventh house is the circle you choose — friends, scenes, the future tense of belonging.
daily.house_12: The twelfth house is the back room — solitude, the unnamed, what you do when nobody is keeping score.

calcCopy.howTitle: How a birth chart is calculated
calcCopy.howP1: A natal chart is a diagram of the sky from one place at one moment. Two inputs do the work: time, which fixes where each body sat along the ecliptic, and coordinates, which fix which part of that sky was rising. Meridian resolves the birthplace to latitude and longitude, converts local clock time to Universal Time with the IANA timezone rules in force on that date, then reads planetary longitudes from a VSOP87-class ephemeris (astronomy-engine).
calcCopy.howP2: Positions are given in the tropical zodiac, measured from the vernal equinox — the Western convention. Sidereal longitudes differ by roughly 24° today and are not shown in this calculator.
calcCopy.whyTimeBody: The Ascendant moves about one degree every four minutes, so a twenty-minute error shifts it by five degrees and can change the sign entirely. The Moon moves roughly half a degree an hour. Sun through Pluto are stable enough across a day that an unknown time still gives a usable chart, minus the houses.
calcCopy.housesBody: Placidus is the default because it is the most widely used, and most published interpretations assume it. It divides time rather than space, which makes houses uneven and breaks down above roughly 66° latitude; for births in the far north, Whole Sign is the more honest choice.
calcCopy.risingBody: The rising sign is the zodiac sign that was coming up over the eastern horizon at the moment of birth. It depends on latitude, longitude and clock time, not just the date. Meridian computes it from local sidereal time and the same tropical ephemeris as the natal chart.
calcCopy.moonTitle: Why the Moon needs a time
calcCopy.moonBody: The Moon travels about 13° a day. A birth time unknown checkbox still returns a sign in most cases, but the degree and house are a noon estimate. For a natal reading, enter the time if you have it.
calcCopy.venusBody: Venus spends a few weeks in each sign and stations retrograde about every 18 months. The sign is stable across a calendar day; the house needs a birth time. Positions are tropical and geocentric, same engine as the full natal chart.
calcCopy.mercuryBody: Mercury changes sign every few weeks and stations retrograde about three times a year. A birth date is enough for the sign on most days; the house and the exact degree still want a time. Positions are tropical and geocentric, same engine as the full natal chart.
calcCopy.marsBody: Mars spends about six or seven weeks in a sign, longer when retrograde. The sign is stable across a calendar day; the house needs a birth time. Positions are tropical and geocentric, same engine as the full natal chart.
calcCopy.synastryBody: Each person is calculated as a full natal chart. The wheel overlays both sets of planets; the table lists major aspects between the two charts using the same orbs as the natal aspectarian (8° conjunction/opposition, 6° square/trine, 4° sextile).
calcCopy.compositeBody: This calculator uses planetary midpoints (the shorter arc between each pair of natal longitudes) and a midpoint Ascendant with whole-sign houses. A Davison chart instead takes the midpoint in time and space and computes a real sky. Both are used in relationship work; they are not the same chart.
calcCopy.horoscopeBody: The sky is computed for today at 12:00 UTC with the same tropical VSOP87-class ephemeris as the natal calculators. Each of the twelve readings treats a natal Sun as 15° of that sign and aspects the Moon (orbs about 8°) plus Mercury, Venus and Mars (about 6°) to that point. If the transiting Sun or Moon occupies the sign, that is named separately. The paragraphs are written templates. This is a Sun-sign proxy, not a natal reading, and not medical, legal or financial advice.

horoscope.title: Daily horoscope
horoscope.indexTitle: Daily horoscope today — twelve signs from the sky
horoscope.lead: Twelve readings from today’s sky, not a recycled column. Each sign is a natal Sun at 15° of that sign. Aspects come from the Moon, Mercury, Venus and Mars at 12:00 UTC.
horoscope.signLead: Transits to a {sign} Sun at 15° of the sign, computed from today’s tropical sky. This is a proxy. A saved natal chart is more precise.
horoscope.natalHint: Sun, Moon, rising and houses from your date, time and place. The cabinet then writes transits to those degrees.
horoscope.methodBody: Meridian computes tropical planetary longitudes for today at 12:00 UTC with the same VSOP87-class ephemeris as the natal calculators. For each sign, a natal Sun sits at 15°. The Moon, Mercury, Venus and Mars are aspected to that point. Occupation of the sign by the transiting Sun or Moon is named separately. Paragraphs are written templates, not a model inventing degrees. Not medical, legal or financial advice.
horoscope.faq1q: Is this the same as the cabinet daily reading?
horoscope.faq1a: No. The cabinet uses your saved natal chart — real degrees, houses, and both fast and slow transits. This page is the public Sun-sign layer: one point per sign, fast planets only.
horoscope.faq2a: A Sun-sign column cannot know your natal degree. Mid-sign is an honest average for everyone with the Sun in that sign. If you have a birth time, calculate the natal chart instead.
horoscope.faq3q: Do you use Vedic or sidereal signs?
horoscope.faq3a: No. Positions are tropical, measured from the vernal equinox. Sidereal longitudes differ by roughly 24° today.
horoscope.quiet: No major Moon, Mercury, Venus or Mars aspects to your Sun are inside orb at noon UTC. That is not emptiness. Do the work already on the desk.
horoscope.sunSeason: The transiting Sun is in your sign. The season is pointing at identity, visibility, and the work you will actually put your name on.
horoscope.moonInSign: The Moon is moving through your Sun sign. Mood and identity share a room. Eat, rest, and do not treat a familiar feeling as a new verdict about who you are.
horoscope.close: This is weather on a Sun-sign proxy, not a rewrite of a natal chart. If you have a birth time, the natal calculator and the cabinet are the more honest instrument.
horoscope.open_aries: You start before the room has agreed it is time. Today’s sky is pressure on that ignition — what to begin, and what to stop treating as a first move.
horoscope.open_taurus: You trust what can be touched, timed, and kept. Today’s sky is weather on appetite and patience: money, food, craft, and the refusal to be rushed.
horoscope.open_gemini: You think out loud and split attention so the day stays interesting. Today’s sky is pressure on the split — two messages, two tabs — and whether the range still looks like range.
horoscope.open_cancer: You take the temperature of a room before you take a side. Today’s sky is weather on the private climate: home, loyalty, and the history other people treat as optional.
horoscope.open_leo: You need the thing to be seen, or it hardly happened. Today’s sky is pressure on the stage — work with an audience, love with witnesses — and what happens when effort goes unwitnessed.
horoscope.open_virgo: You notice the one misaligned stitch and cannot pretend you did not. Today’s sky is weather on usefulness: the edit, the list, the body, the contempt that shows up when nothing is quite clean enough.
horoscope.open_libra: You would rather arrange the conflict than sit inside it. Today’s sky is pressure on the social geometry — the other chair, the contract, the charm that postpones a real decision.
horoscope.open_scorpio: You do not do shallow on purpose. Today’s sky is weather on motive and power: who is bluffing, what will still be true after the performance, and where intensity is a method rather than a mood.
horoscope.open_sagittarius: You need a horizon or you start chewing the furniture. Today’s sky is pressure on the thesis — travel, belief, a bigger map — and what happens when the story gets smaller than your appetite.
horoscope.open_capricorn: You take time seriously, including other people’s. Today’s sky is weather on the climb: titles, structures, the long game, and the fatigue that shows up when the climb is the only personality left.
horoscope.open_aquarius: You stand slightly outside the circle even when you built it. Today’s sky is pressure on ideas and on people-as-a-pattern: scenes, causes, future tense. Warmth has to be chosen.
horoscope.open_pisces: You pick up weather that is not yours and call it a day. Today’s sky is pressure on that permeability — art, care, the unnamed mood in a house — and the difference between compassion and disappearing.
horoscope.hit_moon_conjunction: The Moon is on your Sun. Mood and identity share a room. Eat, rest, and do not treat a familiar feeling as a new verdict. {motion}
horoscope.hit_moon_sextile: The Moon sextiles your Sun. A door is open if you walk through it. Comfort is available; it will not chase you. {motion}
horoscope.hit_moon_square: The Moon squares your Sun. Appetite and will are not on the same page. Do the smaller honest thing rather than the dramatic one. {motion}
horoscope.hit_moon_trine: The Moon trines your Sun. The day wants to go easily. Ease is not a plan — use it, or it becomes drift. {motion}
horoscope.hit_moon_opposition: The Moon opposes your Sun. You meet yourself in other people today. Name what you want before you borrow theirs. {motion}
horoscope.hit_mercury_conjunction: Mercury is on your Sun. Words and identity fuse. Say the one true sentence; do not send the three drafts that dilute it. {motion}
horoscope.hit_mercury_sextile: Mercury sextiles your Sun. A conversation can move work if you pick up the thread. The talent is there; it will not chase you. {motion}
horoscope.hit_mercury_square: Mercury squares your Sun. The argument in your head wants a public. Write it down first. A spat is not a strategy. {motion}
horoscope.hit_mercury_trine: Mercury trines your Sun. Language is on your side. Use it for the message that has to land, not for another tab. {motion}
horoscope.hit_mercury_opposition: Mercury opposes your Sun. You hear yourself in someone else’s wording. Answer the content, not the tone you projected onto it. {motion}
horoscope.hit_venus_conjunction: Venus is on your Sun. Wanting and identity share a room. Choose the pleasure you can stand by tomorrow, not the one that only works as a mood. {motion}
horoscope.hit_venus_sextile: Venus sextiles your Sun. An easy door in taste, money, or company. Walk through it; charm will not do the walking. {motion}
horoscope.hit_venus_square: Venus squares your Sun. Appetite and pride collide. Do not buy, agree, or perform affection just to end the friction. {motion}
horoscope.hit_venus_trine: Venus trines your Sun. Support is native in the social weather. Enjoy it, then still do the work that does not applaud. {motion}
horoscope.hit_venus_opposition: Venus opposes your Sun. You meet your want in someone else. Name the preference before you outsource it. {motion}
horoscope.hit_mars_conjunction: Mars is on your Sun. Drive and identity fuse. Start the one thing that needs heat; do not start three fights to feel alive. {motion}
horoscope.hit_mars_sextile: Mars sextiles your Sun. Effort has a door. Walk through it while the window is open; courage will not book the slot for you. {motion}
horoscope.hit_mars_square: Mars squares your Sun. Will collides with will. The third move is smaller and cleaner than the dramatic one. {motion}
horoscope.hit_mars_trine: Mars trines your Sun. Heat is available without a crisis. Put it into the task already named, or it becomes restlessness. {motion}
horoscope.hit_mars_opposition: Mars opposes your Sun. You meet the fight in other people, and in the part of yourself you keep across the room. Choose the contest worth having. {motion}
